summary.headline: Jupiter’s Establishments by Sign
summary.text: Astrological judgments for planetary establishments in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by Jupiter’s establishments in Aries, Taurus, and Gemini. The thirds and mid-sign positions are interpreted through weather, disease, kingship, famine, social unrest, agriculture, and royal victory.
